description: UPDATES an existing scheduled maintenance by id — this MODIFIES live status-page data and can notify subscribers. Send only the fields you want to change. Instatus: PUT /v1/{page_id}/maintenances/{maintenance_id}. Returns the updated maintenance.

components.description: Component ids affected by this maintenance.

end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the maintenance ends.

notify.description: Whether to notify subscribers about this update.

start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the maintenance starts.

statuses.description: Per-component impact — set each listed component's status for this event.

status.description: The impact status to set on that component.

name: instatus_update_maintenance
title: Update maintenance
